entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: Pivotal event in 4559 AR in which Xenagos ascended to godhood amid a victory celebration in Akros.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Satyr planeswalker who engineered a siege and ascended to godhood as the God of Revels.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City besieged by Mogis's minotaurs where the Great Revel took place.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God whose minotaur horde besieged Akros and who empowered Rhordon.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker and Sun's Champion who killed Daxos while under Xenagos's illusion.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Soldier-oracle who loved Elspeth and was struck down by her.

entities.name: Medomai
entities.description: Sphinx whose vision sent Elspeth and Daxos to Akros.

entities.name: King Anax
entities.description: King of Akros who challenged Rhordon and was grievously wounded.

entities.name: Queen Cymede
entities.description: Queen of Akros who called on Keranos.

entities.name: Rhordon the Rageblood
entities.description: Brutal oracle of Mogis who fought Anax.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: Storm god who answered Cymede's plea.

entities.name: Sarpedon
entities.description: Erebos-bound figure brought by Xenagos and killed.

entities.name: Nikka Takis
entities.description: Safeguarded Elspeth's sword and fled with her.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God whose shrine Elspeth and Nikka climbed to; he later waged a crusade on Xenagos.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of the Great Revel.

events.summary: Elspeth and Daxos arrive in Akros, which is besieged by Mogis's minotaurs, and meet the imprisoned Xenagos.
events.quote: They found the city encircled by Mogis’s minotaurs and a massive barricade cutting off reinforcements.

events.summary: Anax challenges Rhordon while Cymede and Daxos unleash the Deyda River with Keranos's might; Rhordon's horde is swept away and Anax wounded.
events.quote: Rhordon and his minotaur horde were swept away, but Anax was left grievously wounded.

events.summary: Elspeth and Daxos confess their love.
events.quote: Elspeth and Daxos at last confessed their love.

events.summary: Xenagos forces Elspeth to relive her trauma, and she kills Daxos; Sarpedon is also killed.
events.quote: Panicked, she struck down Daxos, realizing too late he was no monster.

events.summary: Xenagos feeds on the frenzied revel to breach Nyx and is crowned the new God of Revels.
events.quote: The mortals’ wild belief crowned him the new God of Revels amid chaos, carnage, and ecstatic dance.

events.summary: Elspeth flees with Nikka Takis to Heliod's shrine, denying Xenagos her sword.
events.quote: Elspeth, reeling, fled with Nikka Takis , who had safeguarded her sword

events.summary: At dawn Xenagos rises into Nyx; Elspeth is branded a traitor and vanishes into the wilderness.
events.quote: At dawn, Xenagos rose shimmering into the starry Nyx, leaving his mortal life behind.

relations.note: Rhordon is Mogis's oracle, empowered by him
relations.quote: Rhordon the Rageblood, a brutal oracle of Mogis

relations.note: confessed love before she killed him
